top_signals.title: Stocks Hold Near Record as Tech Appetite Returns: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks held near a record high on mounting optimism around the artificial intelligence trade and as traders dialed back expectations for Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes. Crude oil trimmed an earlier advance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Drone Strike Sparks Blaze at Key Russian Oil and Fuel Terminal
top_signals.summary: Ust-Luga, the top Russian port for exports of oil and other commodities from the Baltic Sea, caught fire early on Friday following an overnight drone attack from Ukraine. A fire was detected at the port of Ust-Luga as a result of damage from drones, Alexander Drozdenko, governor of Russia’s Leningrad region, said in a post on Telegram on Friday. Firefighters are working to extinguish the fire, with operations ongoing, the official said. In a separate statement later, Drozdenko posted that “All consequences of the attack in the port…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Crunch Worsens as Key Spread Heads for Highest Since 2021
top_signals.summary: Spot copper prices are surging above later-dated futures on the London Metal Exchange, in a condition known as backwardation that’s a hallmark of a deepening squeeze on supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Shinhan Asset Management partners with Plume on tokenized fund pilot
top_signals.summary: Shinhan Asset Management and Plume will test a tokenized fund using a Korean won-denominated ultra-short-term bond fund as its underlying asset.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
